intro: Logging, fishing and farming are the backbone of the economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Timber is a major export, though forests are being cut faster than they regrow. Tuna, copra and palm oil are also exported.

chapters.title: Shell money
text: Traditional shell money is still used in ceremonies.
